subject: Pen test report request — artifacts, scope clarifications, and remediation checklist
messages:
From: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for pen test report + artifacts (Acme Financial)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for running the engagement last month. Acme's compliance team needs the final penetration test report and the supporting artifacts (evidence bundle, asset mapping, sample exploit logs) to close out our SIG questionnaire and to share with our third-party risk reviewers. Specifically they asked for: 
- Final PDF report with executive summary
- Per-host evidence (scans, screenshots) grouped by application component
- Any ephemeral KV/LLM cache dumps or request traces tied to the tested instances

Can you confirm whether you can share the above artifacts and an internal remediation checklist that maps issues to owners and ETA? We're on a tight deadline for the audit window — ideally we'd have these by EOD Thu (2026-05-06).

If there are sensitive items that need redaction or require a secure transfer route, let me know and we can arrange an OOB SFTP or a signed NDA addendum.

Appreciate the help — Susan

--
Susan Liu
Senior Security Analyst, Acme Financial
security@acme.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report + artifacts (Acme Financial)

Monica / Marcus — looping you both in. Acme asked for the full PT report and the supporting artifacts. Monica, can you confirm whether the pen-test vendor delivered the artifact bundle to our secure drive and whether any items are classified as restricted? Marcus, engineering will need to export the KV/cache snapshot and redact PII/keys. Laura — please prepare a remediation checklist mapping each CVE/issue to owners and current ETA; attach as a spreadsheet. Priyom — can you open a SP ticket to track the transfer and mark it as high priority (linked to D-8923).

Deadline: Acme asks EOD Thu 2026-05-06. If we can't meet full artifact transfer, propose a minimal set we can deliver securely and iterate.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report + artifacts (Acme Financial)

Thanks Rishi — quick update from the vendor drop: I confirmed the pen-test vendor uploaded an artifacts bundle to our secure GDrive folder at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmePTArtifacts. Contents include: final_report.pdf (redacted), evidence/ (screenshots & scan exports), and a stack snapshot tarball named stack-kvcache-snapshot.tar.gz.

The stack snapshot contains traces of request IDs and some obfuscated API keys. Marcus — can you please run the sanitization job (sanitizer-v2) on the tarball and produce a redacted version we can send to Acme? If sanitization will take longer than 24 hours, propose what subset we can send (report + evidence screenshots) in the meantime.

Laura — I started a remediation workbook and added initial columns (issue id, severity, owner, ETA). I'll drop a link to the sheet in the ticket.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report + artifacts (Acme Financial)

On Mon, May 4, 2026 at 11:27 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> The stack snapshot contains traces of request IDs and some obfuscated API keys. Marcus — can you please run the sanitization job (sanitizer-v2) on the tarball and produce a redacted version we can send to Acme?

FYI — I kicked off sanitizer-v2 against stack-kvcache-snapshot.tar.gz and it's currently running on the redwood-secure-build host. Estimated completion: 6-8 hours. The job will strip full API keys and replace IDs with stable pseudonyms, remove any raw request bodies that match our PII filters, and produce a checksumed artifact named stack-kvcache-snapshot.redacted.tar.gz. I will also extract a small sample of log snippets (non-PII) to include as evidence.

If the sanitizer hits unexpected file formats I'll escalate back to you, but plan is to have a sanitized artifact ready by EOD Tue (2026-05-05). That gives us time to validate before sending to Acme on Wed.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Susan Liu <susan.liu@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report + artifacts (Acme Financial)

On Tue, May 5, 2026 at 1:05 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> I kicked off sanitizer-v2... Estimated completion: 6-8 hours.

All artifacts validated and transfer plan ready. Summary of deliverables attached: remediation_checklist_v2.xlsx (owners + ETAs), final_report_redacted.pdf, stack-kvcache-snapshot.redacted.tar.gz, and evidence screenshots (zipped).

Transfer method: secure SFTP to Acme's intake host. Priyom — I created SP-4175 to track transfer and set the priority to High; link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SP-4175.

Susan — please confirm the SFTP details and whether Acme needs additional redaction (we removed API keys and truncated request bodies; no production PII was included). If Acme requires a more restricted transfer (air-gapped media or on-prem handoff), let us know immediately and we'll pause the transfer.

Next steps:
- Priyom to open SFTP session and hand off artifacts (target Wed EOD 2026-05-06).
- Owners in remediation_checklist_v2.xlsx to acknowledge and update ETA in two business days.
- Rishi to sign off on the artifact bundle and confirm release.

Thanks team — would like to mark this as complete for Acme's SR once Susan confirms receipt.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: remediation_checklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), final_report_redacted.pdf (pdf), stack-kvcache-snapshot.redacted.tar.gz (tar.gz), evidence_screenshots.zip (zip)
